in_marathi.name: Amrisha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amrisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amrut’, meaning ‘nectar’ or ‘immortal’. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to signify the everlasting nature of the soul.
